adminPassword.desc: AdminPassword - /AdminPassword <password> in chat; also used for RCON and the REST API. No double quotes.

autoUpdate.desc: Runs steamcmd app_update 2394010 before every start.

perfThreads.desc: -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -UseMultithreadForDS. The official docs note that leaving them unset may perform better since v1.0.

publicLobby.desc: -publiclobby: list the server in the in-game community server browser.

restApiEnabled.desc: RESTAPIEnabled. Used by the stop handler to save and shut down cleanly. Do not expose this port to the internet.

serverPassword.desc: ServerPassword. Empty = no password. No double quotes.

steamUser.desc: Steam account that owns Palworld (anonymous Workshop downloads are refused). Log in once interactively, the cached session is reused; no password is stored in the panel.

workshopIds.desc: Comma-separated Steam Workshop IDs (Palworld, app 1623730). Synced into Mods/Workshop and enabled in Mods/PalModSettings.ini on every start. Empty = Mods/ is left untouched.

install.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Download/update the Windows build of the Palworld dedicated server (app 2394010)
# using Linux steamcmd stored in /pufferpanel/steamcmd
set -e
export HOME=/pufferpanel
SC=/pufferpanel/steamcmd
if [ ! -x "$SC/steamcmd.sh" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Installing steamcmd..."
  mkdir -p "$SC"
  curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$SC"
fi
"$SC/steamcmd.sh" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /pufferpanel +login anonymous +app_update 2394010 "$@" +quit

#!/bin/bash
# One-time setup of the Wine prefix in persistent /pufferpanel/.wine
export HOME=/pufferpanel
export WINEPREFIX=/pufferpanel/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="
rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x16 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 &
XPID=$!
export DISPLAY=:99
sleep 2
echo "[pufferpanel] Initializing Wine prefix..."
wineboot --init
wineserver -w
echo "[pufferpanel] Installing Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime (winetricks vcrun2022)..."
winetricks -q vcrun2022 || echo "[pufferpanel] WARNING: failed to install vcrun2022"
wineserver -w
kill $XPID 2>/dev/null
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Sync Steam Workshop mods (Palworld app 1623730) into Mods/Workshop and build Mods/PalModSettings.ini.
# Workshop downloads need a Steam account that owns Palworld (anonymous login is refused).
# The account must be logged in once interactively; steamcmd then reuses the cached session.
export HOME=/pufferpanel
IDS="${workshopIds}"
STEAMUSER="${steamUser}"
SC=/pufferpanel/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh
WS=/pufferpanel/Mods/Workshop
DL=/pufferpanel/workshop-cache
CONTENT=$DL/steamapps/workshop/content/1623730
INI=/pufferpanel/Mods/PalModSettings.ini

if [ -z "$IDS" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] No Workshop IDs set, leaving Mods/ untouched"
  exit 0
fi

ID_LIST=$(echo "$IDS" | tr ',; ' '\n\n\n' | grep -E '^[0-9]+$')

if [ -z "$STEAMUSER" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] WARNING: Workshop IDs set but no Steam user, skipping download (using cache only)"
else
  set --
  for id in $ID_LIST; do
    set -- "$@" +workshop_download_item 1623730 "$id"
  done
  echo "[pufferpanel] Downloading Workshop items as $STEAMUSER..."
  # stdin from /dev/null: if no cached session exists steamcmd fails instead of waiting for a password
  if ! timeout 900 "$SC" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir "$DL" +login "$STEAMUSER" "$@" +quit < /dev/null; then
    echo "[pufferpanel] WARNING: Workshop download failed (no cached login? see template README). Using cache."
  fi
fi

# Replace the folders this script manages, keep anything you put into Mods/Workshop yourself
mkdir -p "$WS"
for d in "$WS"/*; do
  [ -f "$d/.pufferpanel-workshop" ] && rm -rf "$d"
done
for id in $ID_LIST; do
  if [ -d "$CONTENT/$id" ]; then
    cp -a "$CONTENT/$id" "$WS/$id"
    touch "$WS/$id/.pufferpanel-workshop"
  else
    echo "[pufferpanel] WARNING: Workshop item $id is not downloaded"
  fi
done

# Every folder in Mods/Workshop with an Info.json gets enabled by its PackageName
python3 - "$WS" "$INI" <<'PYEOF'
import glob, json, os, sys
ws, ini = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
pkgs = []
for info in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(ws, '*', 'Info.json'))):
    try:
        with open(info, encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print('[pufferpanel] WARNING: cannot read ' + info + ': ' + str(e))
        continue
    pkg = data.get('PackageName')
    if not pkg:
        print('[pufferpanel] WARNING: no PackageName in ' + info)
        continue
    rules = data.get('InstallRule') or []
    if isinstance(rules, dict):
        rules = [rules]
    if rules and not any(isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('IsServer') for r in rules):
        print('[pufferpanel] WARNING: ' + pkg + ' is not marked IsServer=true, it may be client-only')
    pkgs.append(pkg)
lines = ['[PalModSettings]', 'bGlobalEnableMod=' + ('true' if pkgs else 'false')]
lines += ['ActiveModList=' + p for p in pkgs]
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(ini), exist_ok=True)
with open(ini, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
print('[pufferpanel] Active mods: ' + (', '.join(pkgs) if pkgs else 'none'))
PYEOF
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
cd /pufferpanel
export HOME=/pufferpanel
# dwmapi=n,b lets a UE4SS proxy dwmapi.dll (if a mod deploys one) load instead of Wine's builtin
export WINEPREFIX=/pufferpanel/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml=;dwmapi=n,b"

# Virtual display for Wine
rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x16 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 &
export DISPLAY=:99
sleep 2

if [ ! -d "$WINEPREFIX" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Wine prefix missing, initializing..."
  wineboot --init
  wineserver -w
fi

# PalWorldSettings.ini: start from the developer default when missing or empty
INI=/pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/PalWorldSettings.ini
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$INI")"
if ! grep -q '^OptionSettings=(' "$INI" 2>/dev/null; then
  cp -f /pufferpanel/DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini "$INI"
fi

# Overwrite only the keys listed in pal-values.txt (KEY<TAB>VALUE); everything else is kept
awk -v vals=/pufferpanel/pal-values.txt '
BEGIN {
  while ((getline l < vals) > 0) {
    t = index(l, "\t")
    if (t > 0) {
      n++; keys[n] = substr(l, 1, t - 1); v = substr(l, t + 1)
      if (v == "true") v = "True"; if (v == "false") v = "False"
      val[keys[n]] = v
    }
  }
}
/^OptionSettings=\(/ {
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    k = keys[i]; s = $0
    p = index(s, "," k "="); if (p == 0) p = index(s, "(" k "=")
    if (p == 0) {
      q = length(s); while (q > 0 && substr(s, q, 1) != ")") q--
      $0 = substr(s, 1, q - 1) "," k "=" val[k] substr(s, q)
      continue
    }
    st = p + length(k) + 2
    rest = substr(s, st)
    if (substr(rest, 1, 1) == "\"") {
      vl = index(substr(rest, 2), "\"") + 1
    } else {
      e1 = index(rest, ","); e2 = index(rest, ")")
      if (e1 == 0 || (e2 > 0 && e2 < e1)) e1 = e2
      vl = e1 - 1
    }
    $0 = substr(s, 1, st - 1) val[k] substr(rest, vl + 1)
  }
}
{ print }' "$INI" > "$INI.tmp" && mv -f "$INI.tmp" "$INI"

set -- -port=${port} -players=${maxPlayers}
if [ "${publicLobby}" = "true" ]; then
  set -- "$@" -publiclobby
fi
if [ "${perfThreads}" = "true" ]; then
  set -- "$@" -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -UseMultithreadForDS
fi

# This script runs as PID 1 in the container, which ignores signals without a handler.
# On stop: save + shut down through the REST API when enabled, otherwise forward SIGINT;
# kill Wine if the server is still running after the timeout.
stop_server() {
  echo "[pufferpanel] Stopping server..."
  if [ "${restApiEnabled}" = "true" ]; then
    curl -s -m 10 -u "admin:${adminPassword}" -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${restApiPort}/v1/api/save" >/dev/null \
      && echo "[pufferpanel] World saved via REST API"
    curl -s -m 10 -u "admin:${adminPassword}" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"waittime": 1, "message": "Server is shutting down"}' \
      "http://127.0.0.1:${restApiPort}/v1/api/shutdown" >/dev/null
  else
    kill -INT "$WPID" 2>/dev/null
  fi
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    kill -0 "$WPID" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
  if kill -0 "$WPID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[pufferpanel] Server did not exit in 60 s, killing Wine"
  fi
  wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
}
trap stop_server INT TERM

# Job control on: without it bash starts background jobs with SIGINT ignored
set -m
wine ./PalServer.exe "$@" <&0 &
WPID=$!
wait "$WPID"
wait "$WPID" 2>/dev/null
wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
exit 0
